ticksIntoPhase: it is tick - startTick, and the phases falling, impact and explosion are cut from it: the fireball's age, not a position inside one phase

shape: it is returned as it is when it is a function, and becomes the `start` of a shape otherwise
it is handed to toBurstShapeLookup; its default "random" is a start orientation, and a shape is { start, side }
activePhases: each entry is { startTick, endTick, angle, instanceId }, and every loop over the result calls its element fireball
each entry is { startTick, endTick, angle, instanceId } of a fireball in fireballs.manual
